display.title: Summer Vacation: Why Hashem Sends You New Friends
display.summary_short: At the start of summer vacation, Uncle Yossi explains that Hashem arranges which new friends we meet so that we can help them come closer to Torah and mitzvos.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show at the very start of summer vacation. Uncle Yossi lists the good things the free summer months make room for: making new friends, visiting relatives, going sightseeing, day camp and overnight camp. He reminds listeners that nothing happens by chance; through hashgachah pratis Hashem arranges in advance which new friends each child will meet, and gives the strength to help them. So whenever you meet someone new, ask yourself why Hashem sent you this friend, and what you, a soldier in Tzivos Hashem, can do to bring that friend closer to Torah and mitzvos. Sharing your Torah and mitzvos is true Ahavas Yisroel, and in return Hashem will bless you with a happy, healthy and safe summer, so you come back recharged to learn more and do more. Uncle Yossi invites children to write to him at Tzivos Hashem about how they helped another Jew, and reminds them that bringing every Jew closer will bring Moshiach sooner.
display.lesson: Every new friend is sent by Hashem for a reason: use the summer to help that friend come closer to Torah and mitzvos.
